title: The Ledger
summary: Vess, under the ice: drill the plug at the shaft head and hold it (countdown drill) while the old run's machines, a dead Engram walking the shaft in loops, come to see. With choir-fragment the Cantor gives a code that stands them down (cantor-code). Then down to the Ledger: eleven closed columns, one open (cine-ledger, ledger-read).

objectives.text: Hold the shaft head until the drill is through

notes: The hold: the drill countdown runs once it starts; the objective needs it run out AND a unit at the shaft head, so leaving the pad holds the job up at the end (there is no "stay at a site for N s" condition). The Foundry opens off this via foundry-lead-* (any two of dustfall, drop-field, the-ledger). Rime opens off ledger-read via Engram's rime-route.
